name: loop-goal
description: Run a goal through the Jarvis Improvement Loop (loop engineering): ground a sourced pass/fail rubric in real evidence first, then iterate Discover → change → Verify until the goal is verifiably met or it hits an honest plateau. Use when the user types "/loop-goal", or says "loop on this", "loop goal", "loop engineering", "iterate until done", "verify until done", "keep going until it's actually done", "run the loop", or states a goal they want pursued and checked rather than a one-shot answer. Goal-agnostic — works for design tasks, research, prototypes, content/a11y cleanup, and fuzzy "make it better" goals.
